prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["How should your companion fit into your workday?", "Select when your desktop pet should offer break reminders or playful animations.", "Focus & Break Companion", "Continue to Adoption"]
1: ["Choose Where Your Pet Lives", "Select your preferred desktop corner so your pet stays out of your workspace way.", "Bottom Right Corner (Recommended)", "Save Position"]
2: ["Select Companion Greeting Style", "Pick how your desktop pet should get your attention when active.", "Subtle Wave & Soft Sound", "Confirm Greeting"]
3: ["Pet Rest & Active Hours", "Set quiet hours so your pet slumbers while you attend meetings or deep focus work.", "Quiet during 9 AM - 5 PM Focus", "Set Schedule"]
4: ["Select Your Desktop Companion Path", "Pick a premade companion or create a custom pet tailored to your desktop.", "Instant Pet Companion", "Custom AI Companion"]
5: ["Your Pet is Ready on Desktop!", "Press Alt + Pet (or Option + Pet) on your keyboard anytime to show, hide, or talk to your companion.", "Pro tip: Double-click your pet to open its quick action menu on desktop.", "Start Exploring"]
6: ["Preparing Desktop Companion", "We are assembling your pet's animations and sound effects."]
7: ["Choose Your Companion's Personality", "Calm & Quiet", "Playful & Interactive"]
8: ["Desktop Pet Controls Quick Overview", "Click pet to pet or feed", "Right-click for settings & hide"]
9: ["Building Your Desktop Pet", "Play chime when companion spawns on desktop"]
